resources.title: ULTIMATE Quick Start Guide (Beginners) for Baldur's Gate 3
resources.creator: ItalianSpartacus
resources.noteEs: Guía de arranque rápida y completa: clases, creación de personaje, combate y primeras decisiones explicadas para que un jugador nuevo no se pierda. El mejor punto de entrada en video al juego.
resources.noteEn: A thorough quick-start guide: classes, character creation, combat, and early decisions explained so a new player doesn't get lost. The best video entry point to the game.

resources.title: The Ultimate Beginner's Guide to Baldur's Gate 3 - Everything You NEED To Know About BG3
resources.creator: Renfail
resources.noteEs: Repaso amplio de todo lo que un principiante necesita saber antes de empezar: sistemas, vocabulario de D&D 5e y conceptos clave. Denso pero completo.
resources.noteEn: A broad rundown of everything a beginner needs to know before starting: systems, D&D 5e vocabulary, and key concepts. Dense but complete.

resources.title: Baldur's Gate 3 for dummies: Basics for EVERYTHING You Need to Know
resources.creator: Eurogamer
resources.noteEs: Explicación clara y concisa de las bases del juego para quien viene sin experiencia en CRPGs o en D&D. Buen formato corto para entender lo esencial.
resources.noteEn: A clear, concise explanation of the game's basics for anyone coming in without CRPG or D&D experience. A good short format to grasp the essentials.

resources.title: Baldur's Gate 3 Complete Beginner's Guide - BG3
resources.creator: Lucky Ghost
resources.noteEs: Guía extensa de hora y media que cubre el juego a fondo para principiantes. Pensada para verla por partes mientras avanzas tus primeras horas.
resources.noteEn: A long, hour-and-a-half guide covering the game in depth for beginners. Meant to be watched in parts as you progress through your first hours.

resources.title: Baldur's Gate 3: The ULTIMATE Beginners Guide (2025)
resources.creator: EternalTalks
resources.noteEs: Versión actualizada a 2025 con el juego ya completo y parcheado. Formato corto y al grano, ideal si quieres lo esencial sin una guía de hora y media.
resources.noteEn: A 2025-updated version with the game complete and patched. Short and to the point, ideal if you want the essentials without an hour-and-a-half guide.
